description.en: Rounded sediment beads connected in a continuous narrow chain.

scientific_scope.en: Stylized trace-morphology concept. The ichnogenus names the trace, not its producer; sediment surfaces and cross-sections are illustrative. Listed periods refer to source examples, not the complete range.

distinctness.en: Rounded sediment beads connected in a continuous narrow chain.

modeling_brief.en: Use original low-poly facets to emphasize: rounded sediment beads connected in a continuous narrow chain. Keep secondary texture subordinate to the diagnostic geometry; choose one composition, not counted variants. Display convention: raised-fossil-relief; section cuts are illustrative, not an excavated specimen claim.
modeling_brief.zh: 采用原创低多边形几何突出：圆沉积珠由狭窄连线串成连续链。次要纹理服从识别结构；只计一种构图，不靠变体增数。 表现方式：凸起化石浮雕；剖切是示意，不声称复制出土标本。

assets.uncertainty: Reference supports the group or context; select a diagnostic specimen/section and verify the stated shape before modeling. Tracemaker, behavior and relief polarity can be uncertain; never assign a producer species from this concept. The relationship of Hormosiroidea to Halimedides is disputed; this is a visible form concept, not a settled ichnotaxon.

description.en: A dominant upright axis carries repeated complex lateral branch systems.
description.zh: 优势直立轴上重复着生复杂侧枝系统。

scientific_scope.en: Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for Pertica quadrifaria; cited fossils support gross structures, while unpreserved proportions and colour remain artistic choices.
scientific_scope.zh: Pertica quadrifaria 的保守整株重建概念；所引化石支持主要结构，未保存比例和颜色仍属美术选择。

distinctness.en: Ordered lateral tiers and repeated division differ from the simpler Psilophyton spray pattern.
distinctness.zh: 有序侧枝层及反复分裂区别于较简单的Psilophyton枝簇。

modeling_brief.en: Block out the main pole and tiered branched arms first; defer fine fertile tips until species plates are checked.
modeling_brief.zh: 先建立主杆与分层侧臂，再依据种级图版确定细小育性顶端。
